title: Volatility
subtitle: Equity indices and commodities: realized vs implied
headline: Monday 02 November 2026. VIX 21.1 (high), realized 11.6%, spread +9.6 points, curve in contango. The market charges +5.1 points over the HAR+IV model. Top idea: sell WTI vol at the OVX level.

sections.title: S&P 500 volatility
paragraphs: The VIX closed at 21.1, the 86th percentile of its trailing year (high). The S&P 500 realized 11.6% over the last 21 sessions (43th percentile) and 9.9% over 63. Implied sits 9.6 points above realized: options are rich against recent history.

Since 2015 the one-month variance premium (implied today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.5 points and was positive on 83% of days. Today's +9.6 spread is above that average: the seller is paid more than usual going in.

The HAR+IV model, which debiases the VIX with past realized vol, forecasts 16.0% for the next month (pure HAR-RV: 14.7%). The gap between market and model is +5.1 points, in the '4 to 6' bucket. Historically in that bucket the forward premium averaged +3.8 points and was positive 81% of the time.

sections.title: Term structure
paragraphs: Curve: VIX9D 22.5, VIX 21.1, VIX3M 21.6, VIX6M 22.7, VIX1Y 23.1. VIX / VIX3M = 0.979, contango (normal: the market expects vol to mean-revert up). The curve has been inverted on 7% of days since 2015.

The forward vol between 30 and 91 days is 21.8%: that is what the market charges for month two and three, above spot VIX. VVIX at 110 and CBOE SKEW at 153 (89th pct) describe the vol-of-vol and tail pricing.

sections.title: Cross-asset
paragraphs: Among the assets with a CBOE implied index, WTI Crude has the richest options (IV 62.7% vs realized 45.7%, +17.0 points) and Gold the cheapest (+6.0 points). Realized vol percentiles over one year: S&P 500 43th, Nasdaq 100 76th, Russell 2000 40th, Euro Stoxx 50 59th, WTI Crude 52th, Gold 18th, Silver 30th, Natural Gas 53th.

sections.title: WTI crude
paragraphs: OVX at 62.7 (73th pct 1y) against 45.7% realized on the front future. The CLZ26 / CLZ27 calendar spread is +22.2%: the curve is in backwardation.
Samuelson effect today: CLZ26 (0.6 months out) realizes 38% against 14% for CLX27 at 12 months. News hits the front of the curve; the back is anchored by marginal cost.
Selling crude vol at the OVX level earned +4.3 points on average in backwardation (positive 74% of days, worst -40.4) versus -0.6 in the other regime.

sections.title: Scheduled events
paragraphs: Next FOMC decision: 2026-12-09 (36 days). It is outside the 9-day window, so VIX9D carries no identifiable event premium today.

Over 95 meetings since 2015 the term structure priced an average 0.68% move and the S&P realized 0.80% (ratio 1.09, realized above implied on 35% of meetings, max ratio 6.3x on 2024-06-12). Event vol is fairly priced; the generic month is not: the carry lives in the days with no scheduled news.

sections.title: Skew (SPY 30d, last snapshot)
paragraphs: Snapshot 2026-11-03: ATM 16.9%, 25-delta put 20.7%, 25-delta call 14.2%, risk reversal -6.50 points, butterfly +0.53. 5 snapshot day(s) in the history so far.

ideas.title: Sell WTI vol at the OVX level
ideas.instrument: USO / CL 1m variance at the OVX (crude ATM vol sits about 5% below OVX)
ideas.thesis: OVX 62.7 against 45.7% realized. In backwardation the crude variance premium averaged +4.3 points, positive 74% of days. Scarcity regimes have paid the seller.

ideas.title: Sell 1-month S&P variance at the VIX
ideas.instrument: 1m variance swap at the VIX, held to expiry (the premium sits in the wings, not at the money)
ideas.thesis: With the curve in contango, the forward premium (VIX today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.7 points in this bucket and was positive 80% of the time.

ideas.title: Sell the 1-month ATM S&P straddle, delta-hedged daily
ideas.instrument: SPX / SPY 1m ATM straddle at the ATM vol (about 0.8 x VIX), hedged at each close
ideas.condition: VIX - HAR+IV gap in the '4 to 6' bucket (+5.1 pts today)
ideas.thesis: The market charges +5.1 points over the debiased model. In this bucket the straddle kept -0.06% of spot per trade after hedge costs, 53% winners.

stats.unconditional: all 261 trades since 2005: -0.13% avg, 54% hit, worst -9.8% (Sep 2008)

method: Ideas are ranked by historical conditional expectation divided by the historical worst case in the same regime (expected P&L per unit of tail). Conditioning variables: the VIX minus HAR+IV gap bucket, the VIX / VIX3M curve bucket, the WTI Dec/Dec curve regime, the FOMC calendar. Gross of financing, net of hedge costs where stated.
caveats: Free data: Yahoo Finance closes and CBOE indices. Option quotes are delayed; implied vols are rebuilt from mids with Black-76.
Conditional statistics are in-sample averages over overlapping daily windows; treat small buckets as indicative.

The straddle backtest sells at the S&P ATM vol (VXO / sqrt(30/22) to 2021, then VIX x a ratio modelled on VIX and SKEW), with 1 bp hedge cost and 0.5 vol point bid-ask; no margin, no financing. Sold at the VIX it would look far better: VIX prices the skew, an ATM straddle does not get paid for it.
